title: Second cut silage is in
body:
Got the second cut baled and wrapped before the forecast turned. Yield looked strong after the July rain — the reseed two years ago is really paying off.

Big thanks to everyone who lent a hand with the wrapping.

title: Ewes moved to the fresh paddock
body: Rotated the flock onto fresh grazing. All counted and sound. Trimmed a couple of feet while we had them in the pen.

title: First earlies lifted
body:
First of the potatoes out of the ground and they’re cracking. A few boxes are already spoken for — email us if you’d like some while they last.

Carrots and beetroot not far behind.

title: New season, new website
body:
We’ve moved the farm log off its old home and rebuilt it from scratch. Same updates, faster site, and now you can **book a visit** or **get in touch** right here.

Have a look around — and drop us a line if anything’s not working.
